title: CobwebFrame
description: Place items (as many as you like) in cobwebs like in item frames! Texture pack compatibel!
body: --- ##### Place multiple items (any item, incl. blocks) in Cobwebs like in Item Frames --- it's server only but recommend to be installed on both client and server for best performance # Features: - **Place** items by right-clicking a cobweb with an item to store it - Get the items by right-clicking with an empty hand - Break the cobweb to drop all items - **All** items and **all** blocks work! - **Custom** **textures** (e.g. texture packs) work as well! Perfect for **decoration**, **map-building** or **adventure** ## Images Store any item ![Store any item](https://github.com/qwatrum/cobwebframe/blob/master/img/cobwebframe%20(9).png?raw=true) Even Blocks ![Even Blocks](https://github.com/qwatrum/cobwebframe/blob/master/img/cobwebframe%20(4).png?raw=true) And multiple ![And multiple](https://github.com/qwatrum/cobwebframe/blob/master/img/cobwebframe%20(5).png?raw=true) Custom texture pack support ![Custom texture pack support](https://github.com/qwatrum/cobwebframe/blob/master/img/cobwebframe%20(6).png?raw=true) Breaking the cobweb, drops the item ![Breaking the cobweb, drops the item](https://github.com/qwatrum/cobwebframe/blob/master/img/cobwebframe%20(7).png?raw=true) Or by right-clicking ![Or by right-clicking](https://github.com/qwatrum/cobwebframe/blob/master/img/cobwebframe%20(8).png?raw=true) ![example of cobwebframe](https://github.com/qwatrum/cobwebframe/blob/master/img/cobwebframe%20(2).png?raw=true) ![another showcase](https://github.com/qwatrum/cobwebframe/blob/master/img/cobwebframe%20(3).png?raw=true) ![example again](https://github.com/qwatrum/cobwebframe/blob/master/img/cobwebframe%20(1).png?raw=true) ![here is an example](https://github.com/qwatrum/cobwebframe/blob/master/img/cobwebframe%20(10).png?raw=true) ![example image](https://github.com/qwatrum/cobwebframe/blob/master/img/cobwebframe%20(12).png?raw=true)
